account:
Today has been mostly quiet municipal business, but several reports made me curious. The neighbour told me people were discussing unexplained lights at the bakery. The baker said he had not arranged new lighting and had declined the builder's unsolicited offer of repairs or lighting. According to the neighbour, the builder also denied installing those lights. I have not personally verified that any new lights exist, who placed them, or what they are for. My attempt to get the builder's firsthand account did not produce an intelligible reply.

There is also a vague story about a change to a river crossing. The neighbour traced it to Townsfolk 02 and 22, neither of whom supplied specifics or evidence. The neighbour reported that freight knew of no change and builder confirmed safe passage. I asked that either townsfolk speak to me tomorrow if they have firsthand details. At present this is rumour, not an established crossing problem.

Freight handed the secretary a written book, which I saw. The secretary explained that it offers local deliveries for two emeralds per load, with cargo, route and deadline agreed beforehand. It was filed with accounts, and no municipal work has been authorized. The neighbour also reported seeing the baker give freight bread after a discussion of a market delivery. This could simply be ordinary private trade; I have no evidence of a hidden purpose or connection to the lights or crossing rumour.

The secretary reported no correspondence requiring my decision. I have returned home for the evening, arriving at 19:07. Tomorrow I should read my appointment book and keep my appointments, including the ten-o'clock grain inspection at the mill. I remain curious, but nothing I have learned yet establishes a secret scheme or identifies anyone acting improperly.
